digest.component_or_area: live multi-project rehearsal and integration testing
propositions: Live Cloud rehearsal against shared REB and DIG projects failed because non-existent project keys parse-error in real Jira instead of returning empty, causing the inbound fetcher to abort the entire pass with no per-project exception handling.

The stateful fake transport masked real failure modes by returning empty for unknown projects, whereas the real product deliberately fails closed on unknown project keys with no contract tolerating mapped-but-absent projects.
A single live-Cloud instance with only two real projects cannot faithfully model all required repo configurations (one/two/zero repos) plus empty and unknown project states simultaneously.

The rehearsal must run against the ephemeral Jira DC instance where admin rights allow creation and destruction of throwaway scratch projects per run, making it reproducible and CI-verified in the jira-dc-harness job.

Each mutating scenario must be preview-gated before sync, asserting the planned mutation set contains only targets in the intended project with empty intersection against every other configured project.

All provisioned scratch projects must be deleted on every exit path via session-scoped finalizers, with random RBJ-prefixed keys and a session guard preventing reuse of leaked projects from prior runs.
